MobileProfileUpdateBody.description: Updates accepted non-null own-profile fields. Null fields are ignored; at least one accepted field is required. Unknown fields are ignored.

email.description: A plain email address without a display name; empty string clears it.

favourite_player_id.description: Opaque legacy player preference; empty string clears it. This value grants no roster access.

notification_prefs.description: Replaces the whole preference object; up to 64 keys, each 1..64 characters without controls, with boolean values. Null is ignored; an empty object clears preferences.

LegacyMobile.description: Original signed mobile token, accepted only by the explicitly enabled, time-bounded exchange endpoint. CMS/customer and rewrite tokens are excluded.
